name: Ashtaroth
overview: Ashtaroth appears in Scripture primarily as a significant location associated with the kingdom of Og in Bashan, a land inhabited by giants and allotted to the tribe of Manasseh. The city is mentioned as a capital or prominent site where Og reigned, highlighting its historical and territorial importance (Deuteronomy 1:4; Joshua 9:10; Joshua 12:4; Joshua 13:31). Additionally, Ashtaroth is the plural form of Ashtoreth, indicating a connection to the Canaanite goddess, though the biblical text focuses on its geographical and tribal significance rather than its idolatrous associations. The identification of Ashtaroth with Ashtaroth Karnaim further anchors it in the narrative of ancient conflicts involving the Rephaim giants (Genesis 14:5).
